about: binding.json's models map is empty, as it was until 6b03062, so the binding hands Agent Manager the tier's own name (claude-sonnet-5-5 for sign-off, a mid-tier step), which the laptop's Claude Code does not list. The run must stop after one spawn, say Agent Manager's own words in runner.log, and spawn nothing more in the passes after (JP-183).

stopped.reason: needs a fix (bad-model): agent-manager: model "claude-sonnet-5-5" is not one claude lists; it lists default, opus, fable, sonnet, haiku. Fix: name a model Agent Manager lists: fix graphs/tiers.yaml or the `models` map in graphs/bindings/agent-manager/binding.json, then rerun graphs/tools/compile_graphs.py.
